rawFindings.title: Improper handling of missing configPaths in multiConfigPath
rawFindings.explanation: The code assigns this.config_path using multiConfigPath(base, args.config) if args.config is provided. The multiConfigPath function logs a warning if configPaths is falsy and returns the default config path. However, if args.config is an empty string or invalid, multiConfigPath returns the default path but logs a warning. This behavior might be misleading if an empty string was not intended as no config file was entered.
rawFindings.suggestion: Validate args.config before calling multiConfigPath to ensure it is a non-empty string; if invalid, fallback to the default config path without logging a warning.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Invoke Hexo constructor with args.config as an empty string; the code logs a warning 'No config file entered.' and uses the default path. If this is unintended, the warning is misleading.
